summary.fr: Diplômé d'un Master (Bac+5) en Économie de l'Entreprise et des Marchés (Aix-Marseille Université). Deux ans et sept mois chez Allianz Lebanon en santé et épargne retraite collectives : gestion autonome d'un portefeuille de grands comptes (plus de 1 000 adhérents), clôtures mensuelles, participation aux bénéfices, cotations pour courtiers. Puis Responsable opérationnel en alternance chez UDC, startup deeptech : processus, pilotage, finance, paie, recrutement, juridique et automatisation.
summary.en: Master's degree (five-year university degree) in Business and Market Economics from Aix-Marseille University. Two years and seven months at Allianz Lebanon in group health and group retirement savings: autonomous management of a portfolio of key accounts (more than 1,000 members), monthly closing, profit sharing, quotes for brokers. Then Operations Manager (work-study) at UDC, a deeptech startup: processes, steering, finance, payroll, recruitment, legal and automation.

target_roles.track_1_priority: Group insurance and employee benefits (group health, prévoyance, group retirement savings): account manager, chargé de clientèle, junior underwriter, B2B roles at insurers, brokers, mutuelles and insurtechs.
target_roles.track_2: Operations in startups and scale-ups: Ops Analyst, Business Operations, chargé de mission, junior PMO.
target_roles.priority_zone: Operations roles in insurance, insurtech or fintech, where both experiences meet.

title.fr: Souscripteur et gestionnaire de portefeuille clients

allianz.department: Corporate Health department (group health insurance for companies)
allianz.context: Worked through the Lebanese financial crisis.
allianz.power_plan_explained: Power Plan is a group investment and retirement savings solution offered to the employees of client companies. Younes managed a portfolio of client groups, not the product itself.
portfolio: Managed autonomously at least 5 key accounts of 200 to 300 members each, more than 1,000 members in total.
Handled enrolments, contributions, withdrawals, terminations, contract changes and plan adjustments.
Ran compliance checks and analysed guarantees, coverage and exclusions.
Point of contact for members, client companies, brokers, sales teams and internal teams.
finance: Monthly closing of each client group with the finance department.
Sent every movement (new member, contribution change, termination) to accounting and resolved discrepancies.
Calculated the annual profit sharing of the department's client groups on Excel. The calculation went to his manager, then to leadership, who communicated it to the client companies.
Profit sharing explained: the share of the technical result returned to the client when the group's claims stay below forecast.
allianz.underwriting: During about his first six months, prepared weekly international travel insurance quotes for brokers: choice of guarantees and clauses, then pricing. Each quote was validated and countersigned by his manager before going to the broker.
client_relationship: Supported members in their decisions during the financial crisis: enrolments, payments, strategy changes, withdrawals and terminations.
Received written thanks from clients for the quality of service.
Presented Power Plan to new groups and members, with the sales teams.
allianz.representation: Chosen by management to represent the department in the team that organised internal events and reported operational needs. Consolidated the team's needs, identified recurring problems and produced reports for management.
savings_and_fund_switches: Members' monthly contributions were invested in several international funds (unit-linked group retirement savings).
Monitored the performance of these funds.

Presented members with the options for allocating their savings between conservative funds (stable over the long term) and growth funds (more volatile, with higher potential returns), based on their time horizon and risk profile. The member made the decision.
Supported fund switches (moving savings from one fund to another).
Wording rule: say he presented options and guided members. Never say he gave investment advice or managed the funds: he was not an asset manager.

udc.company_explained: French deeptech startup of 6 to 7 employees, specialised in teleoperation and immersive piloting (The Ring).
udc.position: Worked directly with the CEO, the CTO and leadership, with access to confidential information (payroll, contracts, funding).
operations: Turned open briefs and leadership priorities into execution plans: owners, deadlines, dependencies and checkpoints.
Coordinated clients, suppliers, contractors, partners and internal teams, and flagged risks and blockers early.

Created reusable Franchise and Event processes, organised by priority, timeline, owner, documents and deadline. They were applied to the negotiations and contracts of 2 to 3 franchise projects. No franchise has opened yet.
udc.opsboard: Created OpsBoard, an internal steering tool that gathers priorities, progress, decisions, risks and blockers. Leadership can see where execution stands in two minutes, with a log of decisions.
udc.mondial_auto_2026: UDC took part in the Paris Motor Show 2026 (Mondial de l'Auto) as a service provider for Honda. Younes was the link between Honda's requests and UDC's leadership: he received the brief from both sides and ran the execution. Scope: budget, logistics, schedules, shifts, transport, accommodation and coordination of a field team of 5 to 6 people.
finance: Audited the pricing base used for quotes and worked on prices, costs and margins.
Automated quote production: quotes are now twice as fast to produce (50% less time), with automatic numbering and PDF export.
Tracked the budget of each event: planned budget, actual spending and supporting documents.
Worked with the accounting firm on expenses, documents, the balance sheet and closing.

Helped obtain public funding, then built its closing file with leadership and the chartered accountant: expense summary, every transaction justified by invoices and bank statements, breakdown by type of expense, and the cap table.
Prepared financial elements for business angel files: forecasts, cash, revenue, burn rate, runway, MRR and cap tables. These were prepared for the files, not as recurring reporting.
hr_and_admin: Prepared monthly payslips on Silae and paid salaries, with the chartered accountant.
Managed leave, health insurance enrolments and the preparation of permanent employment contracts, with the law firm.
Ran the recruitment of 3 people end to end: job posts on APEC and Indeed, screening, interviews and onboarding.
udc.legal: Worked with the law firm on NDAs, franchise contracts, franchise pre-contract disclosure documents (DIP), contract templates and image rights. He can identify the scope of a clause, the obligations of each party, the applicable version and what a lawyer must validate. He is not a lawyer.
crm: Structured and prioritised more than 1,000 new leads in HubSpot.
Created 6 automated reply templates in French and English in HubSpot, to answer frequent prospect requests faster.

ai_bhq.name: AI Business Headquarters (AI BHQ)
ai_bhq.type: Personal project since November 2026. Not a company, not a founder title.
ai_bhq.explained: A pre-accounting SaaS project for French startups and SMEs. Younes designs and steers it; the code is written by AI development tools (Claude Code, Codex) under his direction. It is a local MVP in progress, on fictional data, with no clients.
ai_bhq.problem: A problem he lived in a startup: invoices scattered across e-mails and supplier websites, transactions matched to invoices by hand, and month-end stress with the accounting firm chasing missing documents before closing.
ai_bhq.built: A finance agent that starts from the bank transactions. For each one, it retrieves the invoice (subscription invoices sent by e-mail, or invoices in the supplier's customer area) and attaches it. For transactions out of its reach, it sends a notification asking the user to attach the invoice. Goal: every transaction has its invoice at month-end, before closing.
verifiable_results: User actions cut from 33 to 5 on the demo.
A first real end-to-end test, which revealed two defects.
ai_bhq.method: Audit, plan, backup, minimal change, tests, report and explicit approval before each step.
ai_bhq.how_it_works: The product currently runs on a deterministic rules engine, with no language model inside yet. Principle: the language model proposes, the rules check, the human validates the exception. A local language model (Ollama) is planned for the next version, not used yet.
ai_bhq.stack: Python and FastAPI, SQLite, n8n (local), HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Git. Built with Claude Code. Security: hashed passwords, secure sessions, strict isolation per company.

working_style.ambiguity: He can work in ambiguity but turns it into clear owners, processes and deadlines.
working_style.initiative: Delivers the requested task first, then proposes a faster, more reliable or safer method.
working_style.learning: Self-directed: documentation, videos and practice until the tool works (HubSpot, Qonto, Stripe, Silae, n8n, AI tools).
working_style.disagreement: Explains his recommendation with evidence, accepts that the manager may know more, then aligns and executes. Conviction without ego.
working_style.mistakes: Acknowledges them directly, says what he learned and how to avoid a repeat.
working_style.feedback: Values frequent, constructive feedback, including on whether it was the right work at the right time.
working_style.decisions_with_missing_information: Checks whether the missing information is critical. If a decision is still needed, prefers the safest reversible option that keeps the project moving.
working_style.tools_and_spending: Tests a light or AI-based solution before paying for expensive software. Prove the need, then invest.
working_style.persuasion: Presents an idea through time saved, money saved and risk removed.
working_style.leadership: Clear expectations, autonomy, trust and accountability. Flexible on method, firm on outcome. He has not yet managed a large team.
working_style.development_area: When strongly invested, he can take on too much himself. He is learning to delegate and make ownership clear. Mention only if asked about weaknesses or delegation.
working_style.motivation: Visible impact, organising projects, building practical solutions and learning. Not rejecting junior work, rejecting stagnation.
working_style.preferred_culture: Clear and measurable objectives, accountability, transparency, honest feedback and team alignment.
working_style.principles: Inspired by The Four Agreements: be careful with words, do not take things personally, do not assume, always do your best. Principles he tries to follow, not claims of perfection.

interview_feedback_learned: From a past case-study interview: he now gives the conclusion first, then the reasoning, then concrete recommendations.
